dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: <color=#FFCC33FF>Would you like to have a chat with me?</color>

dialogues.speaker: Eula
dialogues.text: Didn't think you were the type to get bored... Sure, speak.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Anything happen recently that makes you want to seek vengeance?

dialogues.speaker: Eula
dialogues.text: Not long ago, I took on an assignment to clear out some nearby Treasure Hoarders.

dialogues.speaker: Eula
dialogues.text: On my way back, I rescued a Springvale hunter who was being attacked by a monster.

dialogues.speaker: Eula
dialogues.text: ...I didn't expect him to send meat and wine the next day.

dialogues.speaker: Eula
dialogues.text: Daring to send things despite knowing that I'm the heir to the sinners of Mondstadt... I'll remember this insult.

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: The meat was so good that I ate too much and got a stomach ache, so I couldn't properly enjoy the wine...

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: Haha, we're of the same mind.

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: Just this simple chat with you has made me feel a lot better...

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: Ha, a small fry like that monster can't hurt me.

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: However, the meat was so good that I ate too much and got a stomach ache, so I couldn't properly enjoy the wine...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: It was that delicious? I want some too...

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: Hahaha, best not. If you really want... I'll make a Stormcrest Pie for you.
